kanji.reading_scope: These are the current app lesson-source readings, not a claim of an exhaustive historical reading inventory.

word.reason: A concrete two-character word that retains the gate sense; no specialist or metaphorical sense is introduced.

stroke_identity.identity_note: KanjiVG teaching paths establish stroke order and count. The art plate uses a Shippori Mincho outline; it is a different representation, not pixel-identical KanjiVG geometry.

scene.selected_scene_exact: Rajōmon, Heian-kyō, rain. The character stands as a colossal timber gate at the south end of Suzaku-ōji, centred on the horizon with the avenue running straight into it; through its two lower counters the lamps of the capital are the only warm light, and rain runs down the plank grain. Placement: centre, the avenue below, the city behind.
scene.historical_evidence_status: No historical reconstruction claim is taught by this slice; the selected proposal is creative direction, not historical evidence.

interaction_contract.recall_support: The immediate recall follows exposure; it is a practice experience, not evidence of durable learning.
interaction_contract.outside_review_sessions: Until host exposure marking is explicitly integrated, do not launch from an active graded review or exam.

local_practice_feedback.after_reveal: Retry remains local practice after help; it is not evidence of unassisted mastery.
